subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.-----SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 479 (MP(I)-53). INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: RT-DY (reality dynamics), BIA (bi-aitional) and CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism). From RT-DY: INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) and DEC (decentralization). From BIA: TR (transformation). From CRTF-PROG: LANG (language) and RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From TR: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics).
